description: This file defines the AuthorizationContext interface, including static factory methods, accessors, and JSON serialization details, for handling authorization subjects and context types within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AuthorizationContext.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions used for serializing AuthorizationContext objects to JSON.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.newInstance
methods.description: Factory methods to create new instances of AuthorizationContext with various parameters.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the authorization context.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Returns all authorization subjects in an unmodifiable list.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.addHead
methods.description: Adds authorization subjects at the beginning of the context, returning a new instance.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.addTail
methods.description: Adds authorization subjects at the end of the context, returning a new instance.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.getAuthorizationSubjectIds
methods.description: Returns a list of IDs of all authorization subjects.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.getFirstAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the first authorization subject.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of authorization subjects.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the context contains any authorization subjects.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of the authorization subjects.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the context is authorized based on granted and revoked subjects.

methods.name: AuthorizationContext.toJson
methods.description: Serializes the authorization context to a JSON object, excluding hidden fields.
